items.title: Lawn care
items.description: Mowing, edging and slashing, plus the renovation work that gets a thin or patchy lawn growing again.
items.longDescription: Lawns mown, edged along every path, driveway and bed line, and blown down when we finish. Long grass and overgrown blocks are slashed back first. When a lawn has gone thin, spongy or patchy, we dethatch or scarify it to clear the built-up thatch, aerate compacted ground so water reaches the roots, reseed bare patches, or lay new turf where the old lawn is past saving. Mowing can be a one-off or a weekly to monthly visit, with no lock-in contract.
includes: Seeding, patch repairs and turf laying
items.pageHeading: Lawn mowing and lawn care in eastern Adelaide
items.seoTitle: Lawn Mowing & Lawn Care Eastern Adelaide | GreenEdge Property Care
items.seoDescription: Lawn mowing, edging, slashing, dethatching, aerating, patch repairs and turf laying across Newton, Campbelltown, Norwood, Magill and Adelaide's eastern suburbs. No lock-in contract.
items.beforeAfterSubhead: Two GreenEdge jobs, photographed before and after. Drag the handle to compare.
items.imageAlt: A backyard lawn freshly mown, with a clean edge along the concrete path.

items.title: Pruning & hedging
items.description: Hedges trimmed and shaped, shrubs and roses pruned, and trees thinned to keep them in shape.
items.longDescription: Hedges cut back to a clean, even line and shaped to suit the garden, from a formal box hedge to a screening row along the fence. Shrubs, roses and ornamental trees are pruned, and trees are thinned and shaped to let light through and keep branches off the roof. We also trim climbers and vines before they take over a fence or pergola, remove dead palm fronds, and book seasonal pruning as a regular job. The cuttings leave on the trailer with us.
items.imageAlt: A rose bed along a black front fence after pruning and tidying.

items.title: Garden bed maintenance
items.description: Beds weeded by hand or sprayed, cleaned up, mulched and fed so they stay tidy between visits.
items.longDescription: Weeds pulled by hand from beds and between plants, with weed spraying for paths, paving and larger patches. Beds are cleaned up, shrubs trimmed back off paths and lawn edges, and fresh mulch put down to hold moisture and keep the weeds down. Plants are fertilised to suit the season, and anything dead or past its best can be removed and replaced.
includes: Garden bed clean-ups and shrub trimming
items.imageAlt: A tidied front garden bed of native plants beside a paved path.

items.title: Garden clean-ups
items.description: One-off clean-ups for overgrown gardens, rentals, vacant properties and homes going on the market.
items.longDescription: A complete garden clean-up in one visit: overgrown lawns and beds cut back, weeds cleared, hedges and shrubs trimmed, and everything we pull out taken away. We do end-of-lease clean-ups for tenants and agents, pre-sale presentation before the photos and open inspections, and ongoing maintenance for rental and vacant properties so a house sitting empty still looks cared for. Green waste and hard rubbish are removed from site.
includes: Green waste and hard rubbish removal
items.imageAlt: A back yard with the long grass mown short, seen from under a pergola.

items.title: Planting & plant care
items.description: New trees, shrubs and plants put in, and existing plants repotted or moved to a better spot.
items.longDescription: Trees, shrubs and garden plants planted, watered in and mulched. We also repot plants that have outgrown their pots and move established plants to a spot where they will do better. Planting pairs well with a garden bed clean-up, so new plants go into a bed that has already been weeded and prepared.

items.title: Irrigation & watering
items.description: Irrigation systems inspected and repaired, and sprinklers replaced and adjusted so water goes where it should.
items.longDescription: Irrigation systems checked for leaks, blocked drippers, broken fittings and dry patches, then repaired. Worn or broken sprinkler heads are replaced, and sprinklers are adjusted to water the lawn and beds rather than the fence, the path or the side of the house. Worth booking before summer, when a fault shows up fastest as a dead patch of lawn.

items.title: Pressure washing
items.description: Driveways, paths, patios and pavers cleaned back — before a sale, or after a long winter.
items.longDescription: Concrete driveways, paths, patios, pavers and retaining walls washed back to the surface underneath. Most commonly booked as part of a pre-sale clean-up, or as a reset after winter when moss and algae have taken hold on the shaded side of the house. All equipment and water pressure supplied; we work out the right pressure for the surface rather than blasting everything at maximum.
items.imageAlt: A pressure washer lance cleaning a concrete driveway, leaving a clean strip beside the dirty surface.

items.title: Gutter cleaning
items.description: Single-storey homes. Gutters cleared by hand and downpipes checked to flow.
items.longDescription: Gutters cleared of leaf litter and debris by hand, downpipes checked to confirm they actually run clear, and everything we pull out taken away with us. Worth booking before the first heavy autumn rain and again after leaf drop, especially on the eastern-suburbs blocks with gums or established street trees nearby. Single-storey homes only — we do not carry the roof-access equipment for double-storey work.
items.imageAlt: A roof gutter running along the edge of a tiled roof above a trimmed hedge.

story.heading: One person. Done properly.
story.body: GreenEdge is one operator with a trailer, working out of Newton since 2025. We look after lawns, hedges, garden beds, irrigation, hard surfaces and gutters across Adelaide's eastern suburbs. Maintenance and clean-up work, done properly, rather than a list of everything done badly: no landscape design, no paving, no tree removal. If a job falls outside that, we will say so on the spot and point you to someone who does it.

process.title: You call or send the form
process.description: Tell us the suburb, the service and roughly what you are dealing with. A photo helps. We answer between 7am and 5pm, Monday to Saturday.

process.title: We quote on site, for free
process.description: We come and look at the actual job rather than guessing off a description. The quote is written down before anything starts.

process.title: We book a time that suits
process.description: Usually within the week for a one-off. Regular schedules get a fixed day so you know when to expect us.

process.title: We do the work and clean up
process.description: Green waste goes on the trailer. Hard surfaces get blown down. You get an invoice for the number you were quoted.

items.question: How much does lawn mowing cost in Adelaide's eastern suburbs?
items.answer: It depends on the size of the block, how long the grass is and how often you book. We come out and quote on site for free, and the price is written down before we start, so the invoice matches the quote.

items.question: Which suburbs do you cover?
items.answer: Newton, Campbelltown, Athelstone, Paradise, Rostrevor, Tranmere, Hectorville, Felixstow, Magill, Norwood, Payneham, St Peters, Kensington, Burnside and the surrounding eastern suburbs. There is no travel fee within about 15 km of Newton.

items.question: Is there a lock-in contract for regular mowing?
items.answer: No. Weekly, fortnightly, monthly or one-off — you can change the schedule, pause it over winter or stop entirely with no notice period and no cancellation fee.

items.question: Do you take the green waste away?
items.answer: Yes. Clippings, prunings and gutter debris go on the trailer and leave with us. Your green bin stays empty and nothing gets left on the nature strip.

items.question: Do you clean gutters on double-storey homes?
items.answer: No. Single-storey homes only. Double-storey gutter work needs roof-access equipment and a height-safety setup we do not carry, so we would rather say no than do it badly.

items.question: How much does it cost to pressure wash a driveway?
items.answer: It depends on the size of the driveway and what is on it. Oil stains, or years of moss on a shaded surface, take longer than a general clean. We quote for free after seeing the surface, and the price is fixed in writing before we start.

items.question: Do you do landscaping, paving or tree removal?
items.answer: No. We do garden maintenance (lawn care, pruning and hedging, garden beds, clean-ups, planting and irrigation repairs), pressure washing and gutter cleaning. Landscape design, paving and tree removal are outside what we do. If you need one of those, we will tell you on the spot.

items.question: Are you insured?
items.answer: Yes. Public liability cover is in place. ABN 87 823 119 154. Happy to send the certificate of currency through before we start if you want it on file.

items.question: How quickly can you come out?
items.answer: Usually within the week for a one-off, and often sooner for a straightforward mow. Free quotes are generally booked within a day or two. We work Monday to Saturday, 7am to 5pm.

items.question: Do I need to be home?
items.answer: Not for mowing or pressure washing, as long as we have side access and the gate is unlocked. For the first visit and for gutter work it helps to have someone there so we can walk the job together.
